definitions: A small wheel on a swivel, set into the base of a piece of furniture or other object to enable it to be moved easily.
A small container with a perforated top for sprinkling sugar, salt, or pepper.
A person or thing that casts something, especially in the context of fishing or metalwork.
A type of fine sugar, also known as caster sugar.
examples: He is a skilled fly caster.
Add two spoons of caster sugar.
